name: Heating System Repair and Replacement
description: Helps homeowners by repairing or replacing heating systems that no longer work. Emergency (no-heat) program runs November 1 - April 30.
documents_needed: Name, address, phone, email and LIHEAP number (if you have one)
Copies of electric and natural gas bills

requirements.text: Helps homeowners by repairing or replacing heating systems that no longer work.
You must receive fuel assistance or the utility discount rate for electricity or natural gas.
For homeowners; tenants should contact their landlord.

unknowns: Cost to the homeowner, if any
program_period: Applications from October 1; emergency program November 1 - April 30

first_step.title: Call about your broken heating system
first_step.detail: Call CAPV energy programs at 413-376-1115. Have your electric and gas bills ready.
